panel-icon.tooltip:
Automatic:
- Avatar rounded while up to 50% of users are online.
- Avatar circle above 50%.
- Avatar mask above 75%.
- Duoplatt above 90%.
- If the first Standalone user is online, Duo growth chart is shown.

Random:
- Chooses a random bundled icon once per hour.

Manual icons:
- Choosing a specific icon disables automatic and random switching.

hide-when-inactive.description: Hide applet when no users are active
hide-when-inactive.tooltip: Hides the applet from the panel when no configured user is currently active. The online check keeps running even when activity-based grouping is disabled.

activity-tracking-enabled.tooltip: Controls only activity-based display. Enabled: users reported active by Duolingo are grouped first and highlighted in multi-user views. Disabled: online/offline grouping is skipped; lists use the configured sort first and last-seen as the next tie-breaker. Online detection, last-seen cache updates, active-count labels, automatic icons, and panel hiding keep working.

online-message.description: Send Message when user comes online
online-message.tooltip: Text shown in the speech bubble when a user newly comes online. Placeholders: $user, $count.

offline-message.description: Send Message when user goes offline
offline-message.tooltip: Text shown in the speech bubble when a user goes offline. Placeholders: $user, $count.

hover-self-only.description: Show only Standalone users on hover
hover-self-only.tooltip: Limits the panel hover tooltip to users marked Standalone. When disabled, the hover tooltip shows all enabled users.

hover-display-mode.tooltip: Controls how much information appears in the tooltip when hovering over the panel applet.

click-self-only.description: Show only Standalone users on click
click-self-only.tooltip: Limits the left-click menu to users marked Standalone. When disabled, the menu shows all enabled users.

click-display-mode.tooltip: Controls how much user information appears in the left-click menu. User rows open the matching Duolingo profile when clicked.

panel-display-mode.tooltip: Controls the text shown next to the panel icon. Compact mode shows loaded users, total streak, and active users.

highlight-on-hover.tooltip: Highlights users marked Highlight in the hover tooltip.

highlight-active-users-on-hover.tooltip: Highlights users currently reported active in multi-user hover tooltips.

highlight-on-click.tooltip: Highlights users marked Highlight in the click menu.

highlight-active-users-on-click.tooltip: Highlights users currently reported active in the click menu.

sort-order.tooltip: Controls the second sort level for multi-user hover and click lists. With activity tracking enabled, active users always stay above inactive users. Last-seen is used after this sort order.

users-editor.tooltip: Edit Duolingo users. Each column header has its own tooltip.

users.tooltip: Add one enabled row per Duolingo username. Alias only changes the display name. Standalone limits hover and click views when the matching display options are enabled.

columns.title: Enabled
columns.tooltip: Include this user in Duolingo checks and applet displays.

columns.title: Highlight
columns.tooltip: Highlights this user in the click menu and, when enabled, in the hover tooltip.

columns.title: Simmulate active
columns.tooltip: Simulates that this user is online even when Duolingo does not report them as active.

columns.title: Standalone
columns.tooltip: Shows this user in hover and click views when those views are limited to Standalone users. The first Standalone user is used for self-style panel values and the automatic self-online icon.

columns.title: Username
columns.tooltip: The public Duolingo username. This exact value is used for API requests and profile links.

columns.title: Alias
columns.tooltip: Optional local display name. Leave empty to show the Duolingo username.
